description: February 9 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 3, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 9 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the third decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: The February 9 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: At twenty degrees, Aquarius enters its third decan, which Venus, ruler of fellow air sign Libra, sub-rules. February 9 pairs that softer, more aesthetic tone with the compassionate 9. The tradition here sketches an idealist with charm: someone drawn to social causes, art with a message and friendships that feel like shared projects.

Astronomically, February 9 puts the Sun near 20° Aquarius in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. Venus, ruler of Libra, softens the closing decan of Aquarius, from about February 9 to February 18. The sign's humanitarian streak picks up warmth, charm and a strong sense of fairness. Mid-February birthdays are often described as friendly idealists who care about justice as much as innovation and enjoy art, design and collaboration. Relationships tend to be valued as partnerships of equals. Venus can make them keen to keep the peace even when a principle is at stake. When this decan pairs its vision with its natural grace, it can make change feel welcoming rather than disruptive.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for February 9
paragraphs: Born on the 9th, your birthday number is 9, the last and broadest of the single digits. Numerologists see the birth day as a secondary number that describes a natural gift. The 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and a wide view of humanity, perhaps because it contains something of every number before it. Those with this birthday often find themselves helping, teaching or creating for audiences beyond their own circle. Letting go can be a recurring theme for 9s, along with learning that finishing one chapter makes space for a better one.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a February 9 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous February 9 birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 9 is the 40th day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Pisces, is usually complete within 10 days, by February 19.

Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by February 9 in 79 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it. Among the best-known people with a February 9 birthday are William Henry Harrison (1773), Thomas Paine (1737) and J. M. Coetzee (1940).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 9?
faq.answer: February 9 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 9?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 9 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 9th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 9?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, February 9 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 79 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 9?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on February 9 include William Henry Harrison (1773), Thomas Paine (1737) and J. M. Coetzee (1940). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
